verified_provenance.commit_behavior: The workflow commits data/sleeper_players.json when the generated player database changes.

data_quality_gates: Verify injury_status, practice_participation, depth_chart_order and related fields are present at the historical commit being used.
Measure field-level missingness and semantic continuity before constructing any feature.
Require >=99.5% unambiguous player identity resolution for quantitative player-state work.
Use the Git commit timestamp as a conservative persistence bound; never claim it is Sleeper's official publication timestamp.
Reject any snapshot whose commit time is after the simulated forecast decision timestamp.
Do not use completed 2026 game outcomes to choose fields, coefficients, architectures or thresholds.

rights_separation.note: Technical validity and point-in-time research usability are determined only by the data and integrity of the source. Rights/licensing information is metadata and never changes technical qualification.
